title: Theft — Victor the Bull Suit (Cedar Pavilion)
briefing:
INCIDENT SUMMARY (open file)

On 06 Nov, approx. 07:40, Athletics Equipment reported Victor the Bull's home-game suit missing from Cedar Pavilion Equipment Cage E-12. The suit was on its rack at the 21:03 close-out. The cage door was locked again by morning. Loss window: 21:00–23:00 on 05 Nov, the night before Founders Weekend.

This is the suit, not a generic head and not a storage-room sweep. Four persons of interest are flagged. Jamie's east-service badge, the 22:44 text, and the cage close-out do not agree with each other. A bolt-cutter receipt and a band-hall alibi are both in the file. Pull the pages before you decide who walked out with Victor.

suspects.statement: I worked the Founders Weekend spirit table at the Mill Student Center until about 22:30, then walked home along North Quad. I did not enter Cedar Pavilion or the equipment cage at any time that night.
